overall: The AG found the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law. A quorum attended a mayor's public information session, but the video showed no deliberation, so the notice question was not separately reached.

allegations.summary: A quorum of council members attended a mayor's public information session and allegedly deliberated on the proposed city ambulance service.
allegations.key_passage: Here, it appears from our review of the meeting video that the Council members did not deliberate.

allegations.summary: The information session was allegedly not properly noticed to the public as a meeting of the council.
allegations.key_passage: Generally, a quorum of a public body is permitted to attend a public gathering or training program provided that its members do not engage in deliberation.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
